edges.reason: delegate() is authorized only by require(msg.sender == owner), so caller-controlled msg.sender decides who can reach the delegatecall
The caller-supplied target address a is passed directly as the delegatecall destination
The caller-supplied calldata b is passed directly as the delegatecall payload
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b), running arbitrary code in the token contract context
_mints() gates minting on msg.sender being owner or a hardcoded address
The spender parameter becomes the key whose balance is overwritten in _mints
addedValue directly sets balanceOf[spender], enabling arbitrary balance assignment
_mints writes the balanceOf mapping
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true, bypassing the ensure whitelist
init() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating sale limits
The saleNum parameter is written into the _saleNum state variable
The token parameter is written into the _minSale state variable
The maxToken parameter is written into the _maxSale state variable
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before bulk balance updates
_tos.length is a multiplication operand in the unchecked total computation
_value is a multiplication operand in the unchecked total computation
The unchecked product _value * _tos.length is stored in the local variable total
total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend
batchSend writes recipient balances inside its loop
_tos.length bounds the loop counter i in batchSend
The loop index drives per-recipient balance writes in batchSend
Each loop-local _to receives _value in batchSend
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting a trade address
The addr parameter is assigned to the tradeAddress state variable
msg.sender acts as the spender in the allowance check inside transferFrom
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] before transferring
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] before transferring
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are performed without SafeMath
The unchecked subtraction operation mutates the balanceOf mapping
The _from parameter selects the source account debited in transferFrom
The _to parameter selects the recipient credited in transferFrom
The _value parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
ensure reads tradeAddress as part of the whitelist check
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure computes the candidate pair address via pairFor before falling back to condition
The local _UNI pair address is used inside the ensure whitelist comparison
condition reads _saleNum to limit the number of sales per address
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
pairFor assigns the sorted lower address to token0
pairFor assigns the sorted higher address to token1
transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
The constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder
The constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply

normalization_plan.reason: The address parameter is consumed only as the delegatecall target inside delegate(), so it folds into that unsafe operation
The bytes parameter flows directly into the delegatecall payload of delegate()
The _from parameter is used only to index balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom
The _to parameter is used only as the credited account inside transferFrom
The _value parameter is used only as the transfer amount inside transferFrom
The spender parameter is the balance key written by _mints
The addedValue parameter is the minted balance written by _mints
The saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum exclusively by init
The token parameter is written into _minSale exclusively by init
The maxToken parameter is written into _maxSale exclusively by init
The _tos array is used only for its length and for the per-iteration recipient inside batchSend
The _value parameter is used only as the per-recipient amount inside batchSend
The addr parameter is written into tradeAddress only inside setTradeAddress
The local total is a scratch value derived from the internal unchecked multiplication in batchSend
The loop counter i exists only to drive the batchSend loop
The loop-local _to exists only as the credited address inside batchSend
The local _UNI is the intermediate pair address computed for the whitelist check in ensure
token0 is a sorting intermediate inside the pure pairFor helper
token1 is a sorting intermediate inside the pure pairFor helper
